name: com.lingkyn.platform-services.unity
description: Thin Unity adapter for the Lingkyn Platform Services Core: one IPlatformServicesProvider interface with thin per-vendor shells (Meta Horizon Platform, PICO, Steamworks, Apple Game Center and StoreKit, Unity Gaming Services Cloud Save) each behind its own compile-time define so the assembly compiles with no vendor SDK present; a RecordingPlatformProvider fake with an in-memory account, achievement set, leaderboard, and cloud store; the boot entitlement gate that fails closed with a diagnostic and only opens on an accepted check_entitlement or a consumer-owned fallback, never a scene load or quit on its own; explicit idempotency-key mapping to a client-side dedupe record; an explicit connectivity signal; PlatformServicesProviderConfigAsset ScriptableObjects constructed with explicit references and converted deterministically to the Core's immutable ProviderDescriptor; and a small IPersistedDocumentSource seam so a cloud_write can mirror the same bytes a local save's document holds, without depending on the Persistence package.
